column3: śuddhapakṣasya puṇyāhe parvaṇi vā yathoktam yaṁ sīmantaṁ kaṅkatas te cakāra yad vā kṣuraḥ strīṣu rūpam aśvinau taṁ nidhattaṁ pauṁsyenemaṁ indrāṇī cakre kaṅkataṁ sa sīmantaṁ visarpatu |
punaḥ patibhyo jāyāṁ dā agne prajayā saha |
punaḥ patnīm agnir adād āyuṣā saha varcasā |
dīrghāyur asyā yaḥ patir jīvāti śaradaḥ śatam iti ||
triḥśyetayā śalalyā śamīśākhayā sapalāśayā vā sīmantaṁ |
athāsyāḥ pṛthak keśapakṣau saṁnahyati nīlalohitena edhante asyā jñātayaḥ patir bandheṣu badhyatām iti ||

column9: yo yad yad utpadyate tat tad bhakṣayati sa tādātvikaḥ ||
column21: sa yat karaṇīyaṁ manyeta tat kuryāt ||
